reviews.title: Not worth the money!
reviews.text:
I honestly wish I'd never paid for this app. The free version actually worked better than the paid subscription. As soon as I accidentally upgraded to the yearly plan, it felt like most of the features disappeared behind an even more expensive Pro subscription.
I paid £59.99 for a year's subscription, yet I can hardly use anything without being asked to upgrade again. What's the point of paying if the majority of the useful features still aren't included?
To make matters worse, I realised the purchase was a mistake and requested a refund within a day, but it was refused. I feel completely let down and don't think the app offers anything close to £59.99 worth of value. I wouldn't recommend paying for this app unless you're happy to spend even more money for features that used to be available or that should be included in the subscription.

reviews.title: Zero customer service
reviews.text:
Whilst the app has a few useful features (which many phones have as a standard now anyway) I’ll never recommend this app because when I needed help, I was never helped. They ignored every e-mail I ever sent and to this day, still haven’t bothered responding. 

Anyone thinking of using them, you’ll be on your own and they won’t treat you well at all. Between login failures and zero customer service, 1 star is being generous.

They should be ashamed of their level of customer care.

The developers have since responded to this review saying if I have any issues, to reach out to them via e-mail…………WHAT DO YOU THINK I’VE DOING FOR MONTHS NOW! 

Their developer responses on here just seem like they’re there to sound like they care, when they’ve shown time and time again that they do NOT! 

At this point, if I could give zero stars, I would!
